mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the joint and bones was most worthwhile because the result explained how tendons transmit muscle pulls and why opposing muscles are needed to move the elbow in both directions.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the muscles was predictable after the explanation had already described the completed arrangement. The result appeared to explain muscles before they were fitted, which could confuse the sequence.

surprise.text: The first result described the opposing muscle arrangement before either muscle had been fitted.

arbitrary.text: Neither fitting felt purposeless: each supplied a pull in a direction. Choosing which muscle to add first was arbitrary.

continue.text: I would be mildly interested in continuing to see how the arm gets its supplies and instructions, though this chapter's choices were mostly predictable. The explanation defined tendons, but completing the fittings alone does not show whether a student understands the mechanism.
